releases.name: v2.8-rc.0 - Dapper Crab 🎩🦀
releases.body:
✨ What's New

🎵 Music & Media

  • Compact player – Added a compact, player-focused layout for the opened notch with playback, shuffle, and media-output controls.
  • Remaining time – Added an option to show remaining playback time instead of duration.
  • Now Playing reliability – Improved availability detection, fallback behavior, connection recovery, and user-facing recovery notices when Now Playing is unavailable.
  • Artwork reliability – Fixed artwork disappearing during lightweight Now Playing updates and stale artwork caused by Safari Private Browsing and browser helper processes. — @rogedev, @SpaceCypher
  • YouTube Music / Pear – Improved observer persistence, WebSocket reconnection, connection-state handling, and authentication compatibility. — @cjuriartec
  • Lyrics – Synced lyrics now follow their actual playback timing for smoother line-by-line scrolling.
  • Real-time audio waveform – Added a waveform visualizer option that uses real-time captured audio on supported macOS versions (14.2+), and significantly improved the performance of the original visualizer.
  • Dynamic audio output – You can now control the active audio route, including speakers, wired headphones, AirPods, Bluetooth devices, and external outputs. — @colinchambachan
  • Media gestures – Added horizontal gestures for media controls and improved gesture behavior across the music area.

📅 Calendar & Reminders

  • Weekly calendar view – Added an optional week-based calendar view with a configurable week start: System, Sunday, or Monday. — @TemujinCalidius
  • Join meetings from events – Calendar events can detect supported meeting links and open them directly from the notch. Supports Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Whereby, and Jitsi. — @Subhanshu20101
  • Calendar navigation – Added vertical scroll navigation for the date picker and improved week-based navigation behavior.
  • Reminder date reliability – Improved all-day reminder handling across local time zones and daylight-saving boundaries so reminders retain their correct calendar date.

🎛️ OSD (formerly HUD) & System Controls

  • Renamed HUD to OSD – Now uses the more appropriate term in English, which was already used in some localizations.
  • Smoother brightness control – Brightness adjustments now use smoother stepping with reduced jumps and improved hold behavior. — @benjaminfrombe
  • BetterDisplay & Lunar – Added and improved real-time brightness event streaming and control through external display providers.
  • Key reliability – Improved key interception and recovery.
  • Audio and display routing – Improved handling of built-in and external display/control sources and their availability.

🔔 Notification Mirroring

  • Notifications in the notch – Mirrors visible notification banners in the notch with the sending application's icon.
  • App filtering – Choose whether to mirror notifications from all apps or only selected applications.
  • Notification queue – Multiple incoming notifications can now be queued and browsed from the expanded notification.
  • Closed-notch indicator – New notification activity feedback appears while the notch is closed.
  • Notification reliability – Improved banner discovery, XPC delivery, focus handling, stale-banner handling, and Notification Center interaction.
  • Accessibility-aware mirroring – Notification mirroring now checks Accessibility authorization in real time and provides a direct way to grant access when required.

🔋 Battery

  • Charging wattage – Shows the connected power adapter's reported wattage in the battery popover. — @isaacau502
  • Time until empty – Added a battery discharge estimate alongside time to full charge. — @lasersushi
  • Better charge formatting – Charge estimates now use localized hour/minute formatting instead of a raw minute count. — @lasersushi
  • Battery health – Improved maximum-capacity detection and correctly handles cases where battery-health information is unavailable.

📦 Shelf

  • More reliable Shelf interactions – Improved selection, hit testing, multi-item dragging, context menus, double-click behavior, and Quick Look synchronization.
  • Reverse Shelf ordering – Added an option to keep newer Shelf items at the front. — @yannip1234
  • Shelf controls – Added the ability to disable Shelf behavior entirely when it is not needed.
  • Sharing improvements – Improved Quick Share provider discovery and application-icon handling.

📷 Camera & Mirror

  • Improved camera reliability – Reworked the camera for increased reliability, particularly on multiple-display setups.
  • Camera recovery – Improved permission handling, camera selection, disconnect/reconnect recovery, interruption handling, sleep/wake recovery, and display lifecycle management.
  • Camera selection – Added camera selection for the Mirror feature, with an Automatic mode that prefers the built-in camera. — @ReubenCowell
  • Mirror controls – Added a setting to switch between mirrored and natural camera output. — @anmolmalhotra97

⚙️ Settings & Appearance

  • Reworked Settings navigation – Settings are now organized into dedicated sections for Notch, Appearance, Media, Calendar, Shelf, Mirror, Battery, OSD, Notifications, Shortcuts, and About.
  • Dedicated Notch settings – Added a dedicated Notch section for sizing, hover behavior, gestures, animation, and window behavior.
  • Appearance controls – Moved accent-color customization into Appearance and expanded custom accent-color options.
  • Animation control – Added a setting to control the notch opening-animation speed. — @Amorfx
  • Language selection – Added an in-app language selector with a restart prompt when required.
  • Bug report button – Added an in-app bug report button in the About section which opens the GitHub Issue form page with app version and os version pre-filled

🔄 Software Updates

  • Update channels – Added channel-aware update support for Stable, Beta, and Nightly builds, with the available channels determined by the current build. — @notluquis
  • Safer updates – Improved the updater with additional installer security improvements.

🚀 Accessibility & Onboarding

  • macOS 27 compatibility – Accessibility permission references now use the current macOS terminology (Device Control and Data Access) and localization, with a fallback for compatibility.
  • Improved permission checks – Accessibility-dependent features now properly check authorization instead of sometimes relying on stale permission state.
  • Improved onboarding – Refined permission handling and onboarding flows, including audio-capture permission setup.

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

  • Fixed Shelf files being dragged into WhatsApp as text paths instead of actual file attachments. — @ShehanCes
  • Fixed inconsistent Home ↔ Shelf tab-switch animations. — @ShehanCes
  • Fixed album art alignment in the live activity view
  • Fixed calendar month/year alignment and expanded the clickable area for calendar dates. — @mlbonniec
  • Fixed Apple Music favorite actions. — @karadoganyi
  • Normalized notch gesture direction when macOS Natural Scrolling is disabled. — @karadoganyi
  • Fixed long Quick Share provider names not being centered correctly. — @daemonsloth
  • Fixed notch content being vertically offset on some displays. — @KoukeNeko
  • Fixed the DMG background lookup and clarified the copy-to-Applications installation flow.
  • Removed the deprecated Homebrew quarantine-installation flag and updated related installation guidance. — @ftery0
  • Improved locale-aware formatting across settings, battery, OSD, progress indicators, and accessibility labels.
  • Improved localization coverage for media controls, Shelf actions, native dialogs, and settings.
  • Improved concurrency safety, lifecycle management, and internal architecture to reduce races, retain cycles, and unnecessary background work. — @Dbhardwaj99
  • Updated dependencies used by the project.
